scope: all HHS phase-quantized candidate, lookup, cache, hydration, and accelerator realization paths that possess exact pre-expansion selectors
invariants: 1 <= s_l <= q_l for every selected phase dimension
when exact selectors are available before expansion and M < Q, local realization is mandatory
dense realization is forbidden under an exact selector unless an explicit audit/ablation route is selected
when exact selectors are unavailable, dense reference realization remains permitted
selected candidates preserve their original dense identity namespace
phase-local outputs require exact selected-result equality before downstream authoritative transition
phase-local planning and realization have zero VM81 mutation, persistence, and Hash72 authority
overflow or malformed selector geometry fails closed
runtime timing measurements never participate in canonical authority

routes.LOCAL: exact selector available; realize base_units * M
routes.AUDIT_DENSE: explicit audit/ablation reference; realize base_units * Q

current_exact_abi_bound.reason: uint64 exact product bound with explicit overflow rejection; future wider exact product ABI must be additive

observational_model.note: performance model is empirical and hardware/kernel specific; only exact selector geometry and equality constraints are invariant
